main_text.l: Vt autem melius intelligeretur qui-bus sensim gradibus in tantam tum doctrina, tum morum sanctorum calamitatem Ecclesia Dei Apostolorum praedi-catione tam feliciter & diligenter plantata incideris, adiunximus pro colophone & coro-nide totius huius argumenti appositum pij cuiusdam viri scriptum. quod ille nobis vo-bisque liberaliter communicauit, ex quo tan-ti Ecclesiae lapsus ratio, & ruina gradus, fa-cillime colligentur. Sic autem habet.

page.notes: The initial "V" is a decorative woodcut letter joined to "t" of "Vt". The word "incideris" is read from a worn form; the final letter could be read differently ([?] not added because the reading is fairly clear). The page number "446" is faint and uncertain. The text below the quotation and the ghosted lines at the lower part of the page are show-through from the reverse side and are omitted. The "TRACTA-" line is set as a catchword, the start of the following tractate title, and is therefore not a heading.
